tasks.label: Backend: Run API
args: if [[ -f ../deploy/env/backend.env ]]; then while IFS= read -r line; do [[ -z "$line" || "${line:0:1}" == "#" ]] && continue; key="${line%%=*}"; value="${line#*=}"; case "$key" in CHECKEE_ADMIN_REFRESH_KEY|CHECKEE_REFRESH_REQUIRE_ADMIN_KEY|CHECKEE_ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS) export "$key=$value" ;; esac; done < ../deploy/env/backend.env; fi; export CHECKEE_ENABLE_USER_AUTH=true; ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
